## Sign-off

- [ ] All required pages are indexed.
- [ ] No unresolved `noindex`, duplicate canonical, soft 404, redirect-chain, or structured data errors remain for required pages.
- [ ] Sitemaps have been read successfully by GSC after deployment.
- [ ] Weekly monitoring is scheduled.
- [ ] Evidence screenshots are stored outside the repository in the team's approved location.
